title: 4BR SINGLE FAMILY in Charlotte
description:
Spacious, move-in-ready 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath single-family home offering 1,568 sq. ft. of living space in the sought-after Cabarrus Woods community of Charlotte.

This two-story home features an open-concept living and dining area, creating a flexible layout that works well for everyday living and entertaining.

Recent upgrades include fresh interior paint, new flooring throughout the home, and a stylish new granite kitchen countertop, giving the interior a clean, updated look from day one.

The kitchen is equipped with a dishwasher, microwave, oven/stove, and refrigerator, with the stove and refrigerator less than one year old, so you can enjoy modern, reliable appliances right away.

Comfort is enhanced by central air conditioning. An attached garage provides covered parking and additional convenience, and in-home washer/dryer hookups add to the ease of day-to-day living.

Ideally situated near I-485, the home offers quick access to Charlotte's University City area, including UNC Charlotte, the University City Botanical Gardens, and an extensive network of greenway trails.

You'll also be close to premier shopping and dining destinations such as Concord Mills, Northlake Mall, IKEA, and the Shoppes at University Place, along with nearby grocery options including Publix, Harris Teeter, and Trader Joe's.

4 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, 1 half bathroom in a single-family residence.

Approximately 1,568 sq. ft. of interior living space.

Open-concept living and dining area on the main level.

Fresh interior paint and new flooring throughout the home.

New granite kitchen countertop.

Kitchen appliances included: dishwasher, microwave, oven/stove, refrigerator (stove and refrigerator less than one year old).

Central air conditioning; newer outdoor HVAC unit.

In-home washer/dryer hookups.
